title: The Bible — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: The Christian Bible joins the Old Testament with the New Testament's Gospels, letters, and Revelation. It exists in thousands of translations, making it among the most translated books in history. This overview edition presents The Bible within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
